name: @szl-holdings/ising-calibration-kit
description: SZL re-expression of NVIDIA Ising (pre-decoder cascade + calibration loop + noise-learning) as dependency-free TypeScript primitives. Three runtime-enforced gates on top: content-addressed receipts, mandatory escalation when local-residual exceeds threshold, Jensen-Shannon divergence witness between learned and declared noise models. Inspired by Chamberland/Olle/Li/Thornton/Baratta (NVIDIA, arXiv:2604.12841, Apr 14 2026) and the Quantum-Calibration-Agent-Blueprint by ShuxiangCao et al.; ships no NVIDIA source code or model weights — pattern only.
